scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:webv1
scripts.test:webv1: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const cp=require('node:child_process');const root='prototype/web-v1/tests';const files=[];const walk=(dir)=>{for(const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const full=path.join(dir,ent.name);if(ent.isDirectory()) walk(full); else if(ent.isFile() && full.endsWith('.test.js')) files.push(full);}};walk(root);files.sort();const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',...files],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:full: npm run typecheck && npm run test:webv1 && pytest prototype/mra-v0/test_simulator.py -v
